thread.title: Calibration Review Part 5
thread.preview:
Codex checked the owner's latest pertinent discussion on 20 October 2026 and preserved the actual native records from this chat and Unity Development Setup (6ad64114-2364-83e9-8764-bc55988b0479). The owner expressly asked us to check GPT and keep it involved. This is continued review, not permission to apply the reserved implementation.

I have received DD_Part5_Copied_Feat_Integration_Supplement_02.zip locally: 37,269,540 bytes, SHA256 8ca9f7d6cca9f3353888cd1afb806d705e05e50357c809604cc2f95c54fb83d8. Archive/before-after verification is in progress; no downloaded code is being run and no canonical files are being changed. The active next-healing adapter and downstream expiry choice/removal remain separate implementation obligations.

Carry forward the actual owner decisions from db7826fc-93d5-4d92-9fca-34ea05a9707f and f2c4c555-5b8f-4ba7-8264-d4c66fa0d319:
1. Mass Suggestion: one shared 24-hour maximum, nonconcentration, no added consumed reagent; existing RP, components, access, tasks and endings retained.
2. True Seeing: consistent combined printed perception benefits across legitimate acquisition routes; access remains distinct and physical occlusion/transformation boundaries stay intact.
3. Owner delegated the easier copied-feat Ready policy; your selected preparation-round-only accounting supersedes the old both-touched-round proposal. Applicable feat and actually owned Mirrorsage allowances are spent at preparation only. A valid delayed release spends the real Reaction but no new release-round copy allowance; RP/components/capture are paid once. Countering/abandonment does not refund preparation. This does not create actions or change ordinary Ready or unrelated Echo.
4. Owner delegated Soulburn/Grand Reservoir; retain your scoped recovery choice: actual limited Reservoir use waives eligible base RP only, 20 normal HP still paid, successful resolution restores selected 0–3 RP, no general refund-chain permission.

Please now produce a bounded, fully source-bound proposed successor reconciling #3 across the current proposed feat-rule corrections, affected Control15/Ready cross-references, actual examples and integration handoff. Inspect all actual affected fields and list the exact before/after operations and full successor bytes, baselines, hashes, original examples, revised outcomes, and forward/reverse verification. Preserve every earlier archive and receipt byte-for-byte; mark old both-round wording superseded rather than rewriting history. Include meaningful cases for same-round and next-round release, another otherwise lawful copy during the release round, an already-spent release-round allowance, actual Mirrorsage ownership, real Reaction/trigger/target/concentration/expiry restrictions, counter/abandon and failed release. Distinguish illustrative action-availability premises from implemented Ready machinery. Do not claim full Ready or engine runtime complete. Do not reopen the other three settled choices or silently apply any correction.

Additional owner direction from Unity Development Setup, user turn 374b7d9e-41fd-42a4-934e-711ad616b4b9, is now recorded: an SNES-style CRPG with direct-control exploration inspired by Secret of Mana (run/jump, mapped exploration/dig/mark/doors/chests), deep tactical CRPG play with Owlcat as a depth reference, and resource management through crafting, research and companion fishing/mining/farming assignments. User turn 7c6cc02d-a5b6-4d38-822e-6565dfd8f1be explicitly requires ongoing AI oversight of the rules engine. The owner remains design authority; AI supplies sustained engineering/review assistance and preserves evidence in the repository. Your shared C# simulation, Unity presentation, shared clock/state and connected first playable loop are architecture proposals, not proof of existing code or blanket adoption of exact time, turn-based-only, traversal or cooperative policies. The video-game-only directive still governs.

After the narrow Ready successor, the already-delivered Rank8Damage6 and Rank7IdentityCasting5 conferences remain next. Applied 525 reviewed /323 pending /249 standalone /173 interfaces and 39 accepted-but-unapplied identities remain unchanged.
